blocks.text: The narrative explains that Narain Das was once poor, then attached himself to accomplished ascetics, learned from them, and received a secret pothi whose contents were not meant for common disclosure.
That secret pothi is said to contain hidden arts and guarded teachings, giving Narain Das access to formulas, occult knowledge, and the prestige that comes from appearing to command unseen forces.
The page builds him up not as a rival sovereign but as a figure armed with a secret pothi and the aura of siddhi, preparing the ground for the Guru’s later undoing of his pride.
